observations.behavior: Adds a new async method `adopt_open_table` to the table handle, allowing a caller to reuse an existing table handle rather than opening a new one, with a fallback to False if the incremental read fails.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce redundant table opens and associated metadata reads in warehouse ingestion, potentially lowering latency and resource usage, though the chunk does not show the complete implementation or the benefit of this reuse.
